review.note: Extracted as text from the old lesson, then reviewed against the verified dataset. A line with "review" set is held (not shown) until a teacher resolves it. The old lesson had no data file: the ayat, tafsir and word meanings came from lib/audioUtils.ts, the rest from the components. Dropped: the three Tajweed rules and the two Tajweed quiz questions (Tajweed comes only from the reviewed dataset), the audio URLs and the reciter line, and every hand-typed Quran string (replaced by positions). The complete-the-ayah words are the answers of the old "complete the ayah" and "missing word" games; 4:5 (ahadun) is left out because it looks the same as 1:4 and would show as a wrong option beside it. Not carried over (the engine has no such games yet): the order, listen-and-pick, memory and build-the-ayah games, the two meaning games (same words and meanings as the list and quiz), and the intro quiz (surah name, ayah count). The intro line is the old card's text with its highlight markup removed; emoji were stripped from the ends of lines.

intro.text: سورة الإخلاص تعلمنا أن الله واحد لا شريك له، وهي من أعظم سور القرآن الكريم

tafsir.text: قل يا محمد: الله واحد لا شريك له
الله هو الذي يحتاج إليه كل شيء وهو لا يحتاج إلى أحد
الله لم يكن له ولد ولم يكن له أب أو أم
لا يوجد أحد يشبه الله أبداً، فهو وحده العظيم

words.review: PHRASE: the old entry is "lam yalid" (3:1-2); the engine shows one word, so this points at yalid (3:2) and the meaning carries the negation. Teacher to confirm it reads right.

PHRASE: the old entry is typed "lam yulad" but the ayah reads "wa-lam yulad" (3:3-4); the engine shows one word, so this points at yulad (3:4) and the meaning carries the negation. Teacher to confirm.

quiz.question: ما هي أول آية في سورة الإخلاص؟
ما هي الآية الثانية في سورة الإخلاص؟
ما هي آخر آية في سورة الإخلاص؟
سورة الإخلاص تعدل كم من القرآن في الأجر؟
quiz.review: The hadith (al-Bukhari) says it equals a third of the Quran; "in reward" is one explanation (others: in meaning, tawhid being a third of its themes). Teacher to confirm the wording.

lessons.text: أن الله واحد لا شريك له
أن الله هو الخالق القوي الذي يحتاج إليه كل شيء

reflection.question: لماذا نحب الله ونعبده وحده؟
ideas: نحب الله لأنه خلقنا ورزقنا وأعطانا كل شيء جميل
ونعبده وحده لأنه الواحد الأحد الذي لا شريك له

didYouKnow.text: هل تعلم أن سورة الإخلاص تعدل ثلث القرآن في الأجر؟
didYouKnow.review: The hadith (al-Bukhari) says it equals a third of the Quran; "in reward" is one explanation (others: in meaning, tawhid being a third of its themes). Teacher to confirm the wording.

didYouKnow.text: هل تعلم أن النبي ﷺ كان يحب قراءة سورة الإخلاص؟
didYouKnow.review: The well-known hadith is about a Companion who loved this surah (al-Bukhari); that the Prophet recited it often (in witr, before sleep) is established. Teacher to confirm the wording.

didYouKnow.text: هل تعلم أن سورة الإخلاص من السور التي يُستحب قراءتها قبل النوم؟
